The withdrawal and revocation date time stamps will not be stored if data destruction date is also requested; Previously added on 9/28/21; Updated notes: The data destruction, withdrawal, and revocation dates are populated hierarchically (data destruction > withdrawal > revocation). Data destruction is the highest priority in the hierarchy and includes HIPAA revocation and withdrawal. If requested on the same instance (i.e., same date/timestamp) as withdrawal and/or revocation, only the data destruction D/T is populated and all other related D/T remain null. If data destruction is requested later than withdrawal or revocation, multiple D/T are populated with their respective timestamps.(6/5/26)
